# Zoho
> Cloud software suite for businesses, offering 55+ integrated applications for sales, finance, collaboration, IT, and custom app development.

Zoho provides end-to-end business software for organizations of all sizes, with strong coverage across CRM, workplace productivity, finance, customer support, analytics, low-code development, and AI. Its platform emphasizes privacy, deep product integration, and global business operations.

## Core Platform
- [Zoho Home](https://www.zoho.com/): Main entry point to Zoho’s business software suite and platform overview.
- [Zoho One](https://www.zoho.com/one/): Unified operating system for business with bundled access to Zoho applications.
- [All Products](https://www.zoho.com/all-products.html): Directory of Zoho applications across business functions and teams.
- [Enterprise](https://www.zoho.com/enterprise/): Overview of Zoho’s enterprise capabilities, scale, governance, and platform breadth.
- [About Us](https://www.zoho.com/aboutus.html): Company background, mission, values, and long-term product philosophy.
- [Our Story](https://www.zoho.com/ourstory.html): History of Zoho, its evolution, and guiding principles.

## Sales and Marketing
- [Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/): Customer relationship management platform for sales automation and pipeline management.
- [Zoho Bigin](https://www.zoho.com/bigin/): Pipeline-centric CRM designed for small businesses and simple sales processes.
- [Zoho Campaigns](https://www.zoho.com/campaigns/): Email marketing software for campaigns, automation, and audience engagement.
- [Zoho Marketing Automation](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/): Marketing automation platform for journeys, lead nurturing, and campaign orchestration.
- [Zoho Social](https://www.zoho.com/social/): Social media management for publishing, monitoring, and team collaboration.
- [Zoho Forms](https://www.zoho.com/forms/): Online form builder for lead capture, workflows, and data collection.
- [Zoho SalesIQ](https://www.zoho.com/salesiq/): Live chat and customer engagement platform with visitor tracking.
- [Zoho Thrive](https://www.zoho.com/thrive/): Loyalty, affiliate, and customer rewards platform for growth programs.

## Customer Service and Operations
- [Zoho Desk](https://www.zoho.com/desk/): Help desk software for ticketing, support automation, and omnichannel service.
- [Zoho Assist](https://www.zoho.com/assist/): Remote support and unattended access software for IT and service teams.
- [Zoho Lens](https://www.zoho.com/lens/): Augmented reality remote assistance for field service and troubleshooting.
- [Zoho FSM](https://www.zoho.com/fsm/): Field service management for scheduling, dispatching, and work order execution.
- [Zoho Creator](https://www.zoho.com/creator/): Low-code application platform for custom business process automation.
- [Zoho Flow](https://www.zoho.com/flow/): Integration and workflow automation platform connecting apps and business systems.
- [Zoho Tables](https://www.zoho.com/tables/): Work management platform for tracking tasks, workflows, and team operations.

## Finance and Back Office
- [Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/books/): Online accounting software for invoicing, expenses, and financial operations.
- [Zoho Invoice](https://www.zoho.com/invoice/): Free invoicing software for creating, sending, and tracking invoices.
- [Zoho Billing](https://www.zoho.com/billing/): Subscription billing and recurring revenue management platform.
- [Zoho Expense](https://www.zoho.com/expense/): Expense reporting and travel expense management for businesses.
- [Zoho Inventory](https://www.zoho.com/inventory/): Inventory and order management software for stock and fulfillment control.
- [Zoho Payroll](https://www.zoho.com/payroll/): Payroll processing software for employee salary and compliance workflows.
- [Zoho Practice](https://www.zoho.com/practice/): Practice management software for accounting firms and client operations.
- [Zoho Checkout](https://www.zoho.com/checkout/): Hosted payment pages for collecting one-time and recurring payments.

## Collaboration and Productivity
- [Zoho Workplace](https://www.zoho.com/workplace/): Suite for email, documents, chat, meetings, and team collaboration.
- [Zoho Mail](https://www.zoho.com/mail/): Business email hosting with custom domains, admin controls, and collaboration tools.
- [Zoho Cliq](https://www.zoho.com/cliq/): Team messaging and collaboration platform for chat, channels, and automation.
- [Zoho Meeting](https://www.zoho.com/meeting/): Online meeting and webinar software for remote collaboration.
- [Zoho WorkDrive](https://www.zoho.com/workdrive/): Cloud file management and collaboration platform for teams.
- [Zoho Writer](https://www.zoho.com/writer/): Online word processor for collaborative document creation and automation.
- [Zoho Sheet](https://www.zoho.com/sheet/): Spreadsheet application for analysis, collaboration, and data workflows.
- [Zoho Show](https://www.zoho.com/show/): Presentation software for creating and delivering slide decks online.

## HR, IT, and Internal Systems
- [Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/): HR management software for employee records, attendance, and performance.
- [Zoho Recruit](https://www.zoho.com/recruit/): Recruitment software for staffing agencies and internal hiring teams.
- [Zoho Payroll](https://www.zoho.com/payroll/): Payroll platform supporting salary processing and employee compensation workflows.
- [Zoho Connect](https://www.zoho.com/connect/): Internal communication and employee engagement platform for organizations.
- [Zoho Vault](https://www.zoho.com/vault/): Password manager for teams with secure credential sharing and access control.
- [ManageEngine](https://www.manageengine.com/): Zoho’s IT management division for infrastructure, security, and operations software.
- [Qntrl](https://www.qntrl.com/): Workflow orchestration software for process control, approvals, and compliance.
- [Site24x7](https://www.site24x7.com/): Monitoring platform for websites, servers, applications, and cloud infrastructure.

## Analytics, AI, and Data
- [Zoho Analytics](https://www.zoho.com/analytics/): Self-service BI and analytics platform for reporting and dashboards.
- [Zia](https://www.zoho.com/zia/): Zoho’s AI assistant for insights, automation, and intelligent business workflows.
- [Zoho DataPrep](https://www.zoho.com/dataprep/): Data preparation and pipeline tool for cleaning and transforming datasets.
- [Zoho RPA](https://www.zoho.com/rpa/): Robotic process automation for repetitive business and desktop tasks.
- [Zoho Sign](https://www.zoho.com/sign/): Digital signature platform for secure document signing and approvals.
- [Zoho LandingPage](https://www.zoho.com/landingpage/): Landing page builder for campaign conversion and lead generation.
- [Zoho PageSense](https://www.zoho.com/pagesense/): Conversion optimization platform with testing, analytics, and personalization.

## Developer Platform and APIs
- [Zoho Developer](https://www.zoho.com/developer/): Developer hub for building extensions, integrations, and custom applications.
- [Zoho API Console](https://api-console.zoho.com/): Console for creating OAuth clients and managing API access.
- [Zoho CRM Developer](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/): CRM developer resources for APIs, extensions, and customization.
- [Zoho Creator Developer Docs](https://www.zoho.com/creator/help/): Documentation for building and automating custom apps in Creator.
- [Deluge](https://www.zoho.com/deluge/): Scripting language for business logic, automation, and custom functions.
- [Catalyst](https://catalyst.zoho.com/): Serverless development platform for building scalable business applications.
- [Zoho Flow Help](https://www.zoho.com/flow/help/): Documentation for app integrations, triggers, and workflow automation.
- [Build Skills for Zia](https://www.zoho.com/zia/build-skills): Guide for creating custom skills for Zoho’s AI assistant.

## Help, Documentation, and Learning
- [Zoho Help Center](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/home): Central support portal for product help, tickets, and knowledge resources.
- [Zoho CRM Help](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/crm): Knowledge base for Zoho CRM setup, features, and administration.
- [Zoho Desk Help](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/desk): Documentation for support workflows, ticketing, and service automation.
- [Zoho Books Help](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/books): Product documentation for accounting, invoicing, and finance workflows.
- [Zoho Mail Help](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/mail): Help articles for email hosting, migration, and administration.
- [Zoho Creator Help](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/creator): Guides for app building, automation, and deployment in Creator.
- [Zoho Learn](https://www.zoho.com/learn/): Knowledge management and training platform for teams and internal documentation.
- [Zoho Community](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/community): Community forum for product discussions, questions, and best practices.

- [Trust Center](https://www.zoho.com/trust.html): Central resource for privacy, security, compliance, and reliability information.
